cases.title: BROKEN VARIANT of N01: the drawing is saved by the driver after CDREBUILD, so the file on disk changes (must FAIL)
cases.plan_item: red-before-green proof for N01 (UX-STD-03 CDREBUILD half, daily card D18)
cases.expected: This variant is wrong on purpose: a save happens after CDREBUILD, so the file hash and time on disk differ from the start and the check 'copy-unchanged' fails. The CDREBUILD wording checks before it still pass.
cases.why_not_unit: It exists only to prove N01's file-unchanged check can go red when a save really happens in AutoCAD.
